header_layout: row1 = block headers; row2 = check-code numbering (col N ~ code N-2); row3 = repeated headers + first brand marker 'STACER'; data starts row 4; brand divider rows repeat headers mid-data

blocks.name: Brand section marker
blocks.structure: 9 divider rows only (STABICRAFT..OBSOLETE); Stacer section starts at sheet top without a marker

blocks.name: (empty)
blocks.structure: always empty

blocks.name: Identity
blocks.structure: BOAT display name | Model Code (natural key) | Matrix (brand key into Price Matrix.xlsx) | Image Link (URL)

blocks.name: Hull specifications
blocks.structure: BRAND-DEPENDENT LABELS. Generic (row1): HullLength, Beam, Depth, ImageType(10), LOAincEngine, LOAonTrailer, HOT, [14 unused], FuelCapacity, HullWeightDry, MaxMainMotorWeight, [18 unused], Bottomsides, Topsides, Transom. Highfield divider row relabels: 7=OA Length, 8=Beam, 9=Tube Dia., 11=Int Length, 12=Int Width, 13=Deadrise, 16=Max Load, 17=Max People, 19=Boat Weight, 20=Air Chambers. Values are strings with units ('46 kg','65 ltr').

blocks.name: Standard Factory Inclusions
blocks.structure: col23 title; cols 24-74 = SFI-01..51, free text, one inclusion per cell (inflatables often pack everything into SFI-01); col74 usually the spec-change disclaimer

blocks.name: Factory Options
blocks.structure: col76 title; cols 77-241 = FO-01..165, option CODES (e.g. VWRAP01, BIM35PL, HEC001-BG, CAPC 10.5WA26-264) that key into Factory Options Module.xlsx; '.' = empty slot

blocks.name: Landed-cost chain
blocks.structure: Currency, EX Rate, Duty, [246 spacer], Base Cost, Factory Discounts x2 (248 amount / 249 second line), Boat Prep, Base Freight, Documentation, Fumigation, Ocean Freight, Fuel Surcharge, Other Charges (all factory-currency), Other Chg $A, Road Freight (AUD), Landed Hull Cost (AUD). NOTE: divider rows relabel some of these per brand (e.g. Highfield: 251='ABP Compl.', 252='Factory Pre Rig', 254='Cav Plate Ext', 255='Road Freight', 256='Stamp Duty', 257='Devanning')

blocks.name: Current factory promos
blocks.structure: promo name/validity, Full Rebate (inc GST), Factory Contribution (inc GST), NSM Contribution (inc GST); populated on only ~69-77 rows

blocks.name: Markups (from Price Matrix)
blocks.structure: HO-MU, BMT-MU, Factory Options-MU, Dealer Fit Options-MU, Admin Load, Warranty Adj — per-row copies of the brand row in Price Matrix.xlsx

blocks.name: Pre-delivery header
blocks.structure: Pre Delivery Code (franchiseCode_modelCode_PD), Boat PD (hrs), Labour Rate ($/hr ~130.09), Boat Detailing ($), Fuel Allocation (L), Tilt Limit Switch (Yes/No)

blocks.name: P/D Parts & Accessories
blocks.structure: 10 slots, display-name references to Parts Module items fitted at pre-delivery ('MFM50 - Battery MFM50'); 'NR - Not Required' / '.' sentinels

blocks.name: Handover
blocks.structure: Boat Hand Over (hrs), Tie Down Straps, H/O Parts & Accessories x2, H/O Other-1, Sundry Charges-1 ($), Promo Gear Allowance ($)

blocks.name: Registration
blocks.structure: Boat Registration length band ('Up to and inc 4.5m', '4.51m to 6.0m', ...), Boat Rego Decals option

blocks.name: Safety gear
blocks.structure: Adults (capacity), Standard Safety Gear (water class), PFD's Sup. (qty), PFD Type, Standard Anchor Kit

blocks.name: Motor envelope + Motor Option 1
blocks.structure: Min HP, Max HP ('25 HP' strings), Shaft Lgth (S/SS/LS/XL/'Sng UL / Twin XL'), Eng Configuration (Tiller/Remote), Recommended Motor Option (display name), Rigging Kit Option, Prop Part No. (Yamaha part#), Prop Description, Engine Hole

blocks.name: Motor Options 2-13
blocks.structure: 12 blocks, 6-col stride each: [spacer('.')  , Motor Option N, Rigging Kit Option, Prop Part No., Prop Description, Engine Hole]; block N starts at col 318+6*(N-2); 'NR - ENGINE NOT REQUIRED' sentinel fills unused slots

blocks.name: Trailer options
blocks.structure: Std Trailer + Trailer - Option 2..10, display-name references into Trailer Module (code prefix embedded in name, e.g. 'TALS749S13 - T Light Alloy...', 'REDCO Sportsman - RE1213'); 'TRAILER NOT REQUIRED' sentinel

blocks.name: Additional Dealer Fit Options
blocks.structure: col401 title; Lines 01-42, display-name references to dealer-fit items in Parts Module ('Tube Covers to suit Hypalon Boat - 3.8 Mtr'); '.' sentinel

blocks.name: Deposit payment schedule
blocks.structure: col445 title; Pending/Security, Confirmed Deal (0.2/0.3), Leaving Factory (HIN), Notice of Arrival, On Handover — fractions of price summing to 1.0

blocks.name: Factory lead times
blocks.structure: col452 title; Lockout, Build, Completion, Shipping, Estimated Lead Time — all in days

blocks.name: Hull Only Pricing
blocks.structure: col459 title; (price inc GST, GP% ex-GST) pairs: Cash, Trade, Sub Dealer, Sub (Exclusive), AUS Sailing, Warranty, Spare 2-5 (contain '#VALUE!' error strings)

blocks.name: Paint & Graphics
blocks.structure: col481 title; Opt 01-30 = paint/graphics option codes (GLOSS-DB, SUR-SOLID-White, SIG-HCOL-BW) or plain text; cols 512-514 'NB: Leave Blank'

blocks.name: Pre-Delivery tiers x3 (Basic/Standard/Complex)
blocks.structure: three 11-col blocks at 516/528/540 (+1 spacer between): Description, PD Code (PD-{BRAND}-{BAS|STD|COM}), Est Hrs, Labour $, Parts CTD, Sundry CTD, Sublet CTD, Total CTD, GP %, GP $, Sell (inc GST)

blocks.name: Engine labour allowances
blocks.structure: Motor PD Labour (hrs), Motor Install Labour (hrs), Rigging Kit Labour (hrs), [555 spacer], Total Engine Labour Allowance (hrs)

blocks.name: MPDC — Mechanical Pre-Delivery Check List
blocks.structure: col558 title; Lines 1-50 = workshop checklist TEXT ('Clamps tight', 'Check lock port to STB') incl. section headings (BOAT/FUEL SYSTEM/STEERING/BATTERY/ACCESSORIES/MOTOR/TRAILER); near-identical boilerplate replicated on every boat row; Line 50 unused

blocks.name: DPDC — Detail Pre-Delivery Check List
blocks.structure: col610 title; Lines 1-30 = detailing/valet checklist TEXT ('Wash and Cham', 'Cut and Polish', 'NSM Stickers x 2'); same boilerplate pattern

blocks.name: (empty gap)
blocks.structure: no data

blocks.name: Spare scratch block
blocks.structure: header 'Spare' + numbered cols 1-7,17-24; 23 rows used; col 678 contains the literal 'END' marker

blocks.name: PHANTOM
blocks.structure: no values anywhere; stale worksheet dimension. Row 2 cols 703-732 hold a duplicated check-code fragment (589-618)

brand_counts.definition: rows with a Model Code, excluding 7 brand-divider rows (Model Code='Model Code') and 2 pseudo-sale rows
brand_counts.duplicate_note: most duplicates are the same SKU listed once in the current section and once in the OBSOLETE section (rows >= 1005)

dropdowns.sheet: Dropdowns (hidden), 3479 rows x 26 cols; only cols 3,8,20,22,24,26 populated; '0' and NBSP cells are formula-artifact blanks

col3_boat_list.purpose: master BOAT-name list (pseudo sale rows + all brands' section headers + boat display names) — data-validation source for boat pickers

col8_boat_list_continuation.purpose: continuation of the boat list (Highfield + Formosa)

col20_trailer_options.purpose: trailer vocabulary (REDCO/Dunbier/Mackay/GFab/Stacer trailers + 'TRAILER NOT REQUIRED') — source for Std Trailer / Trailer-Option cols 390-399

col22_motor_options.purpose: motor vocabulary ('Yamaha - F2.5SMHB' ... ePropulsion electrics) — source for Motor Option cols

col24_propeller_options.purpose: propeller vocabulary — source for Prop Description cols

landed_cost.formula_inferred: Landed Hull Cost = (Base Cost + Factory Discounts + Boat Prep + Base Freight + Documentation + Fumigation + Ocean Freight + Fuel Surcharge + Other Charges) / EX Rate  [+ Duty, untested: 0 in samples]  + Other Chg $A + Road Freight (both already AUD)

verify_row445_highfield.check: 4504/0.7 + 300 + 490 = 7224.2857 EXACT — EX Rate is a divisor (USD 0.7 per AUD 1), matching HelmLogic exchangeRates/USD semantics

hull_only_price_relations_row445.trade: 11343 = Cash x 0.95 (5% trade discount per Price Matrix)
hull_only_price_relations_row445.sub_dealer: 9850 = Cash x 0.825 (17.5% discount per Price Matrix)
hull_only_price_relations_row445.markup_base: Cash ~= Landed x (1 + HO-MU 0.5) x 1.1 GST, then rounded/hand-set (11920 calc vs 11940 listed)
hull_only_price_relations_row445.gst_note: all hull-only + PD Sell prices are INC GST; landed cost is ex-GST

price_matrix.file: Price Matrix.xlsx (sheet 'Price Matrix'), the target of the Boat Module 'Matrix' column
price_matrix.semantics: Sell/Factory Options/Dealer Fit = MARKUPS on cost; Trade/Sub Dealer = DISCOUNTS off retail (header note: 'Trade/Sub Dealer Pricing is Discount...')

anomalies: Worksheet dimension 4731x4144 vastly overstates content: last non-empty row = 2301, last non-empty col = 678 (col 678 holds an explicit 'END' marker); 3,466 phantom columns + ~2,430 phantom rows
Row 2 is a 'Check Code Referance' [sic] numbering row; a stale duplicate fragment of codes 589-618 sits at cols 703-732 inside the phantom zone

Brand divider rows are header rows IN the data: col 1 = brand marker, col 4 = literal 'Model Code', and they RE-DEFINE the semantics of spec cols 7-21 AND parts of the landed-cost chain per brand (Highfield: 9=Tube Dia., 16=Max Load, 17=Max People, 19=Boat Weight, 20=Air Chambers; 251='ABP Compl.', 252='Factory Pre Rig', 256='Stamp Duty', 257='Devanning')
Two pseudo-boat rows: 'Motor Repower Sale' (Model Code 'Motor Quote Module') and 'Trailer Sale' ('Trailer Quote Module') — quoting entry points, not boats
633 Model Codes appear more than once — mostly current-vs-OBSOLETE duplication; OBSOLETE section (rows >= 1005) holds 1,193 rows = 59.6% of all boat rows
Two adjacent 'Factory Discounts' columns (248, 249); col 249 mixes text labels ('Ship Craddle' [sic]) with amounts
Spec/HP/capacity values are unit-bearing strings ('46 kg','65 ltr','25 HP','15 deg','287 cm') requiring parsing; Highfield rows put cm/deg values under '(Mtr)' headers
Hull-only 'Spare 2-5' columns contain literal '#VALUE!' error strings on ~1,948 rows; some GP% are negative (loss-priced hulls, e.g. -8.5%)
Price Matrix says Highfield exchange-rate currency '$A' but every Highfield boat row uses USD @ 0.7 — matrix row is stale, boat rows + Exchange Rates sheet agree
Cap Camarat boats are priced via the 'Merry Fisher' matrix row (both are Jeanneau franchises, code 9JE)
MPDC Line 50 effectively unused (header-only); MPDC/DPDC boilerplate is denormalized — identical ~80-line checklist text repeated on every one of ~1,964 rows
Typos throughout: 'Check Code Referance', 'Total Enginge Labour Allowance', 'Models that ar No Longer Available', 'Propellor', 'Ship Craddle'

Row 4 col 457 stray 'Hull Only Pricing' value; openpyxl warns the x14 Data-Validation extension is unsupported (dropdown wiring not fully introspectable, but Dropdowns sheet + observed values pin it down)
Divider rows for YAMAHA (949-950) and Administration (951-952) carry marketing copy in the STANDARD FACTORY INCLUSIONS block ('WHY REPOWER?', 'NEW TRAILERS')

Hull Only Module model codes are space-padded ('HBC 066') vs Boat Module 'HBC066' — key normalization required to join; its prices are a stale snapshot (16.06.2025): HBC066 SELL 11,850 vs Boat Module Cash 11,940, cost 7,299.46 vs landed 7,224.29
